title: AIHWBench: vendor-neutral benchmarking of local AI runtimes
description: AIHWBench is a local-first, offline-capable, zero-dependency Python framework for benchmarking local AI inference runtimes (Ollama, llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, LM Studio and others) across CPUs, GPUs and NPUs. It records measured metrics only — unavailable metrics stay null, never estimated — with schema-validated result documents, reproducibility metadata, privacy scanning, provenance bundles and comparability classification.
